title: Task Tracker
objective: Build a task-management interface that lets users add, complete, edit, and remove tasks.
scenario: Build a task-management interface that lets users add, complete, edit, and remove tasks. Build in increments, keep a written acceptance checklist, and verify one failure or boundary case per major workflow.
target_skills: Filter by all, active, and completed
Edit task titles without losing focus
Show useful empty states and task counts
